culprit_citations.quoted_text: ADG, LLC, GEDC Equity, LLC and RC IV GEDC Investor LLC prior-period Class A common units: 10,000,000 shares/units, amortized cost 29.4, fair value 18.6 in the comparative SOI block.

findings.detail: Rows flagged by PP03 localize to the December 31, 2023 comparative SOI block retained under the June 30, 2024 report date.

rationale: PP03 is a real data error. The filing contains distinct June 30, 2024 and December 31, 2023 investment schedules: the current SOI total is 24,973.4 at table 66 row 22, while the comparative SOI total is 22,873.7 at table 132 row 25. A flagged ADG Class A common units row is present in the comparative block at table 91 row 9, separate from its current counterpart at table 21 row 11. Retaining rows sourced from that earlier-period block under the 2024-06-30 holdings report date is a comparative-period leak, not a false alarm.
